description: Look up MIME types by file extension and extensions by MIME type — searchable reference of 100+ common types.

faqs.a: MIME types (media types) tell browsers and servers what kind of data a file contains, e.g. image/png or application/json.
Yes — type either a file extension or a MIME type; the search matches both directions.

faqs.a: The most common web, image, audio, video, document, font and archive types. Rare vendor types may be missing.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Type a file extension (e.g. webp) or MIME type (e.g. image/webp).
